_note: Matched against class names by the keywords below (case-insensitive, first match wins, so specific entries come before general ones). Add entries freely.

entries.title: BODYPUMP™ HEAVY
entries.what: BODYPUMP variant with heavier weights and fewer reps per track, aimed at building strength rather than endurance.
entries.bring: Towel, water. Barbell and plates are provided.
entries.tip: Do a few regular BODYPUMP classes first to get the technique down.

entries.title: BODYPUMP™
entries.what: Barbell workout with light-to-moderate weights and lots of reps. Tracks work squats, chest, back, triceps, biceps, lunges, shoulders and core to music.
entries.bring: Towel, water. Barbell, plates and step are provided.
entries.tip: Start lighter than you think, because the high rep count adds up fast.

entries.title: BODYCOMBAT™
entries.what: Non-contact martial-arts cardio: punches, kicks and knee strikes from karate, boxing, taekwondo, capoeira and muay thai. No equipment.
entries.tip: Learn the moves at low impact first, then add power.

entries.title: BODYATTACK™
entries.what: High-energy sports-inspired interval class that mixes aerobic moves (running, lunging, jumping) with strength and stabilisation.
entries.tip: Low-impact options are shown for every track.

entries.title: BODYBALANCE™ / BODYFLOW™
entries.what: Yoga, tai chi and pilates set to music. Builds flexibility, core strength and calm, and ends with relaxation.
entries.bring: Comfortable clothes, barefoot. Mats are usually provided.
entries.tip: A good recovery session between harder days.

entries.title: BODYSTEP™
entries.what: Full-body cardio on a height-adjustable step: up, over and around it, plus strength tracks for conditioning.
entries.tip: Start with the step at its lowest setting.

entries.title: BODYJAM™
entries.what: Dance-cardio class built on the latest dance styles and music. The aim is the feel of the moves, not perfect technique.
entries.tip: Choreography repeats, so it clicks by the second or third time.

entries.title: LES MILLS CORE™ (formerly CXWORX)
entries.what: Short, intense core training with bands, plates and bodyweight: abs, obliques, glutes and lower back.
entries.tip: Pairs well right after a cardio class.

entries.title: LES MILLS GRIT™ Strength
entries.what: 30-minute HIIT with barbell, plates and bodyweight to build strength and lean muscle.
entries.tip: Max effort in short bursts; rest is part of the plan.

entries.title: LES MILLS GRIT™ Cardio
entries.what: Bodyweight-only HIIT for speed, power and maximum calorie burn.
entries.tip: No equipment, so it is easy to drop into.

entries.title: LES MILLS GRIT™ Athletic
entries.what: Sports-conditioning HIIT with step, plates and bodyweight: agility, power and speed.
entries.tip: Plyometric, so warm up your ankles.

entries.title: LES MILLS GRIT™
entries.what: 30-minute high-intensity interval training in Strength, Cardio or Athletic formats, often run as small-group team training.
entries.tip: Check which format is on before you go.

entries.title: RPM™
entries.what: Indoor cycling to music: climbs, sprints and flats. You control resistance and speed.
entries.bring: Towel, water, padded shorts if you like.
entries.tip: Ask the instructor to help set up your bike the first time.

entries.title: LES MILLS SPRINT™
entries.what: 30-minute HIIT on an indoor bike: short all-out efforts, low impact on the joints.
entries.tip: Short and brutal, and done in half an hour.

entries.title: SH'BAM™
entries.what: Fun, easy-to-follow dance workout to chart music. No dance experience needed.
entries.tip: The best class to bring a friend to for the first time.

entries.title: LES MILLS DANCE™
entries.what: Dance workout to the latest music, with styles changing every release.
entries.tip: Go for energy over precision.

entries.title: LES MILLS TONE™
entries.what: Mix of cardio, resistance and core work with bands and light weights, finishing with stretching.
entries.tip: An all-rounder if you can only do one class a week.

entries.title: LES MILLS CEREMONY™
entries.what: Combines strength training (dumbbells), boxing combinations and core work to live-style music.

entries.title: Barre
entries.what: Ballet-inspired small, controlled movements for legs, glutes and core.
entries.tip: Small moves with a big burn.

entries.title: LES MILLS CONQUER™
entries.what: Combat-inspired functional training with boxing bags and bodyweight work.
entries.bring: Towel, water, wraps if you have them.

entries.title: Zumba®
entries.what: Latin-inspired dance fitness (salsa, merengue, reggaeton) as a party-style cardio workout.

entries.title: Yoga
entries.what: Postures (asanas) and breathing for flexibility, strength and relaxation. Styles range from calm (Hatha, Yin) to dynamic (Vinyasa, Power).
entries.bring: Comfortable clothes. Mats are usually provided.

entries.title: Pilates
entries.what: Mat-based core and stability work with a focus on control, breathing and posture.

entries.title: SHAPES
entries.what: Listed under Les Mills in the Superfit plan. I couldn't verify the program details offline, so ask at the studio or check lesmills.com.

entries.title: Bauch (Abs)
entries.what: Short, focused abdominal and core session: crunch variations, planks and anti-rotation work.
entries.tip: Easy to tack onto the end of another workout.

entries.title: Beine und Po (Legs & glutes)
entries.what: Squats, lunges, bridges and band work for legs and glutes.

entries.title: TRX® Suspension Training
entries.what: Bodyweight training with suspension straps. You set the difficulty by changing your body angle, and every move also trains the core.
entries.tip: Walk your feet back to make it easier and forward to make it harder.

entries.title: Fullbody Workout
entries.what: Full-body circuit that hits legs, push, pull and core in one short session.

entries.title: Mobility
entries.what: Joint mobility and active stretching drills for hips, spine and shoulders.
entries.tip: Great before or after a lifting session.

entries.title: Circuit
entries.what: Station-based interval circuit: short work blocks, quick rotations. The WOMEN tag marks women-only sessions.

entries.title: Faszientraining (Fascia training)
entries.what: Foam rolling and dynamic stretching to loosen fascia and improve mobility.

entries.title: Rückenfit (Back fitness)
entries.what: Strengthening and mobilising exercises for the back and trunk to prevent and relieve back pain.

entries.title: Bauch-Beine-Po (Abs, legs, glutes)
entries.what: Classic toning class for abs, legs and glutes using bodyweight, bands and light weights.

entries.title: Indoor Cycling
entries.what: Instructor-led stationary-bike class with intervals and climbs.

entries.title: HIIT / Circuit
entries.what: Short, intense work intervals with brief rests, often rotating through stations.

entries.title: Functional / Team Training
entries.what: Small-group coached training with kettlebells, sleds, ropes and bodyweight, built on everyday movement patterns.
entries.bring: Towel, water. Places are often limited, so check whether you need to book.

entries.title: Boxing / Kickboxing
entries.what: Punching and kicking combinations, pad work and conditioning.
entries.bring: Towel, water, gloves or wraps if you have them.

entries.title: Stretch / Mobility
entries.what: Stretching, fascia rolling and mobility drills for recovery and range of motion.
